scope_declarations.backward_error_scope: Maximum over incremental_factor and incremental_operator in every positive and near-duplicate-kernel diagnostic record. Fresh-reference errors are reported but are not thresholded by this criterion; any incomplete trajectory makes the all-complete criterion false.
scope_declarations.guarded_error_scope: Maximum incremental_vs_fresh_same_dtype Aw relative error over every guarded signed-downdate success. A guarded failure makes the all-complete criterion false and is never omitted from the maximum/error accounting.
